import sys

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    n = len(s)
    ans = 0
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        c = s[i]
        j = i
        count = 0
        while j < n and s[j] == c:
            count += 1
            j += 1
        i = j
        if count % 2 == 0:
            ans += 1
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
